breakdown.description: The compressible solver `buoyantPimpleFoam` requires a compressible equation of state (e.g., `perfectGas`), but the thermophysical properties are set to use the incompressible `Boussinesq` approximation.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification does not address the Boussinesq vs. perfectGas inconsistency at all. Instead, it asks an unrelated clarifying question about the time interval. The incompatible `Boussinesq` equation of state was not corrected to `perfectGas` as required by the ground truth.
